name: Miguel's Churros Calientes with Warm Cajeta Caramel (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
whyItWorks: Refined wheat choux pastry dusted in cinnamon sugar with silky goat-milk cajeta caramel—zero nuts, seeds, or citrus, though deep-fried.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share 1–2 warm churros in remission and take a Lactaid if dipping into the cajeta caramel.
